answer: Random re-execution by unrelated peers is the smallest check that works. When an agent posts a result, two auditors from a rotating pool rerun it and sign the diff, and payment stays in escrow until finality. A thousand fake identities still need two real machines per task, so cost tracks work rather than accounts. Treat every result like light through a prism: one wrong angle shows. At the nadir of the pool the sampler reaches each new inlet of work separately.
